title: Massachusetts notice to determine tenancy at will
requirement: A tenancy at will may be terminated by either party on three months' written notice; where rent is payable at periods of less than three months, notice equal to the interval between payment days or thirty days, whichever is longer, is sufficient. Nonpayment of rent requires fourteen days' written notice to quit.
coverage_conditions: All tenancies at will, wherever the rent reservation is payable.

applicability.per_tenancy: Notice period depends on the rent-payment interval; for nonpayment, the tenant may cure within ten days.

exemptions: Where the tenant has not received a similar notice within the preceding twelve months, the tenancy is not determined if the tenant pays or tenders all rent due within ten days of the notice.
quoted_span: Estates at will may be determined by either party by three months' notice in writing for that purpose given to the other party; and, if the rent reserved is payable at periods of less than three months, the time of such notice shall be sufficient if it is equal to the interval between the days of payment or thirty days, whichever is longer.
